class: Alternative resume entry misclassified as required login
symptom: Already registered? Login diverted the agent away from From Device and other available application entry choices.
root_cause: Any password field and already registered text became an authentication/account-exists requirement.
why_tests_missed: The live portal variant was not represented in regression fixtures.
fix: Treat existing login as optional only beside explicit choose-any-option-to-apply wording and multiple known resume entry alternatives; live login errors retain priority.
prevention: Retain synthetic coverage for the observed portal contract and preserve neighboring working behavior.
